comment: #8042 (#7905): the canonical tag UID. backend/tests/filament/test_tag_uid_vectors.py checks spools/models.py clean_tag_uid and MIFARE_UID_SUFFIX against this file, and frontend/src/lib/tagUid.test.ts checks frontend/src/lib/tagUid.ts cleanTagUid, so the server and the browser clean a UID alike. A 4-byte (8 hex digit) UID is the AMS's form: the UID and then the suffix. None and all zeros are null; any other length is its last 16 hex digits, upper case.
